HÀ NỘI — Map 1: phân bổ children under 5 đến cơ sở y tế; Map 2: điểm trẻ 5–14 tuổi và trường học. Population: Meta HRSL/WorldPop 2020; boundaries: GADM 2022; facilities: OpenStreetMap; distance: straight-line distance. The greedy allocation and equal capacities are synthetic, not official OT results. Vaccination services have not been verified.

How to filter layers
1. Use the layer panel in the top-right corner.
2. Map 1 (vaccination): enable population, filter routes by distance, and toggle facility types.
3. Map 2 (schools): enable sampled children aged 5–14 and schools.
4. Enable commune centroids to inspect route origins.
Hover for details; click a facility to view its simulated load.
